messages:
Kai: FYI customer reported being billed twice after an SSE disconnect + quick reconnect. They got the streamed resume but then another full output finished and a second charge.
Anita: ok can you paste their session id and any logs they sent?
Kai: session id cli-xyz. customer provided a tiny repro: client disconnect at ~400ms, reconnect ~300ms later. no idempotency header. request was just:
```http
GET /v1/stream?model=gpt-mini HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.example
Authorization: Bearer user-token-abc
Accept: text/event-stream
```
Kai: their server-side excerpt:
```
[2026-03-03T12:01:22.430Z] conn=42 session=cli-xyz SSE: open
[2026-03-03T12:01:22.820Z] conn=42 session=cli-xyz SSE: chunk seq=1
[2026-03-03T12:01:23.120Z] conn=42 session=cli-xyz SSE: client closed (net err)
[2026-03-03T12:01:23.421Z] auth: rotate token user-token-abc -> user-token-def
[2026-03-03T12:01:23.700Z] conn=43 session=cli-xyz SSE: open Authorization: Bearer user-token-def
[2026-03-03T12:01:23.705Z] request id=req-9a start new generation (no idempotency-key)
[2026-03-03T12:01:25.800Z] generation complete id=req-9a cost=xx
```
Anita: looks like auth rotation happened while client was reconnecting. Did they see a 401 on the reconnect path?
Kai: they reported one 401 just before reconnect. their client refreshes the token and retries the whole request without an idempotency key.
SRE-Bot: Deploy-Notifier: roll/infra/rotate-auth finished at 2026-03-03T12:01:23Z :rocket:
Jorge: classic auth-rotation + naive retry. Two immediate mitigations:
- SDK/docs: require/preserve X-Idempotency-Key across reconnects
- Runtime: detect near-duplicate requests from same session/fingerprint and suppress duplicate generation
Maya: i created a local repro that mimics this. node SSE client that on error refreshes auth and creates a new EventSource without idempotency. gist snippet:
```js
// simplified
let es = new EventSource(url, { headers: { Authorization } });
es.onmessage = m => console.log(m.data);
es.onerror = () => {
  Authorization = refreshToken();
  es = new EventSource(url, { headers: { Authorization } });
};
```
Maya: run instructions:
```bash
python test_sse_server.py --rotate-after-ms 500
node naive_client.js
```
Kai: my local logs show two overlapping generations and two billing entries. attaching to ticket.
Anita: customer asked about refund. i think we should provisionally refund and investigate.
Jorge: suggested short-term + long-term plan:
1) CS: refund + collect full headers/timestamps from customer (short-term)
2) SDK: persist idempotency key (UUID) across reconnects and surface in examples
3) Runtime: implement a 5s dedupe window keyed by prompt+model+user fingerprint; return dupe_suppressed if matched
4) Longer: introduce sticky session header (X-Redwood-Session-Id) that survives token rotate for resume semantics
Maya: proposed runtime dedupe pseudo:
```
finger = hash(model + prompt_trunc + user_id)
if seen_recent_completed[finger] and now - seen_recent_completed[finger] < 5s:
  return cached output + mark "dupe_suppressed"
else:
  process normally
```
Jorge: also add request.fingerprint to billing logs so we can correlate charges to a fingerprint.
Kai: action items:
- [CS] refund + collect sanitized request headers and exact timestamps (Anita)
- [SDK] persist idempotency-key across reconnects and publish patch (Maya)
- [Runtime] implement short-window dedupe + add fingerprint to charge logs (Jorge)
- [Docs] add streaming reconnect guidance and examples (Maya/DevExp)
Anita: i'll respond to the customer: refund issued, we're investigating and will push SDK + runtime mitigations. tagging billing.
SRE-Bot: Incident: billing-dup-dedupe condition created task #BR-4321
Kai: saving artifacts to ticket 2026-CSR-8872. thanks team.
